title: Carrion
summary: CARRION, noun 1. The dead and putrefying body or flesh of animals; flesh so corrupted as to be unfit for food. 2. A worthless woman; a term of reproach. CARRION, adjective Relating to dead and putrefy

inlines.v: CARRION, noun 1. The dead and putrefying body or flesh of animals; flesh so corrupted as to be unfit for food. 2. A worthless woman; a term of reproach. CARRION, adjective Relating to dead and putrefying carcasses; feeding on carrion as a carrion-crow.
